# DDS – Digital Document Sharing


Request, collect, and file client documents securely from the Pega Sales Automation Contacts.

### Overview


DDS lets advisors exchange documents with their clients directly from the Contact record in Pega. An advisor sends a document request with a custom message, and the client uploads through a secure guest portal after passing a one-time passcode challenge sent to their email or phone. Each advisor also has a reusable upload link to share over any channel, and files received through it appear on a Pega landing page where the advisor assigns them to the right contact. DDS runs inside the firm's own network and passes every document through to the firm's existing content repository without keeping a copy. Users sign in through the firm's identity provider using SAML, OIDC, or Microsoft Entra OAuth. DDS is built for financial services, insurance, and banking firms that collect sensitive client documents and must satisfy architecture, security, and compliance review.


### Key Features


- Embedded DDS panel on the Pega Contact record for both Constellation and Theme Cosmos applications
- Contact-specific document requests with an advisor-authored rich-text message
- Reusable per-advisor upload link that can be shared by email or any other channel
- One-time passcode challenge on every guest link, with support for MFA, passwordless sign-in, and mobile biometrics
- Pega landing page for triaging uploads, with multi-select assignment and re-assignment to contacts the advisor owns
- Malware scanning through a firm-provided or IQZ-provided engine, with file type and size limits
- Pass-through storage into the firm's existing content repository
- In-Pega notification center, plus email notifications that link to the guest portal
- Self-hosted deployment inside the firm's network, connected to cloud-hosted Pega over a private VPC link
